payload.summary: PDF extractor can turn prose beneath a table into a table row and rebuild the table markdown from it
payload.detail: worker/python/extract_pdf_assets.py recover_table_rows_from_edge_strip (~:557, caller ~:1367-1390) admits blocks by position alone (four bbox tests) and treats each line as a cell, then rebuilds the whole accessible table markdown, which reaches the vision model, document_table_facts (threshold_value/action) and page.text/search. Also appends recovered rows unsorted, drops single-baseline rows silently, has no test, and worker/python/** is outside the coverage inventory. Next action: accept a recovered block only when its line x-positions align with table.rows cell bboxes, sort by y0, drop the row on alignment failure, cover the markdown rebuild path too, and add a synthetic test (3-column table followed by a 3-line paragraph asserting no new row and unchanged accessible_table_markdown).
